data.body:
STORE FINDING UPGRADED (not a one-off). MCP-side gate_status durable now reports 'stale-store'
TWICE (f9b9 at ~T+13m, 9ca8 at ~T+30m), interleaved with healthy 'unsigned' reads on 87cb/8ce5.
Refined diagnosis: MCP-server READS reconverge and succeed (slowly — one show_ticket took >120s
but returned correct current data), while the plan-review gate's attestation-currency check is
FAIL-CLOSED on divergence and refuses whenever it catches the store mid-reconverge. So the 7
in-flight MCP gate runs may complete their LLM work yet fail to persist a signature.
Root condition (pre-existing, not caused by this run): main checkout's tracker worktree
.tickets-hotpath-authoritative pins refs/heads/tickets at cb530119 (2026-08-15) vs origin/tickets
cbb71cf7 (2026-09-02); 2492 vs 154520 commits past merge-base 75b82339.

CONTINGENCY (no force, no store surgery): if the MCP gates fail to sign, RE-RUN the plan reviews
via the local CLI from this worktree, whose store view is healthy. Justification: AGENTS.md makes
the local CLI the documented carve-out/fallback, and op-cert environment binding is ADVISORY not
enforced — committed rebar.toml sets neither verify.require_environment nor
verify.opcert_enforce_since (ADR 0104 decision 3) — so a worktree-signed attestation is valid.
This is NOT a gate bypass: the gate runs in full and still signs. Agents must not and will not
use --force; if the store itself needed repair (rebar tracker-maintenance refuses on unpushed
ticket commits, and its --force is human-only) that would be escalated to the operator instead.
Detector: the free local 'review-plan --status' poll is correct for EITHER route, since a
signature from either propagates to origin/tickets. MCP polling stopped to reduce contention.
